verdict.rationale: Resend publishes an official MCP server. Its llms.txt says to add Resend to Cursor, Claude and other MCP clients, and a .well-known/mcp.json manifest points to the first-party github.com/resend/resend-mcp repo. The docs and changelog also cite the MCP server as a supported way to verify domains and manage webhooks. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of the MCP server working, and detailed setup/authentication and tool-coverage documentation in the pack.
